newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks hit new unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks hit new unofficial record close.

text.p: Mexican stocks advanced in heavy trade to chalk up their second record close in a row on Thursday.
Dealers said foreign bulls stepped into the market encouraged by a soaring Dow Jones and a "virtuous circle" of favorable domestic and international economic news.
Preliminary closing prices placed the leading IPC share index up 46.07 points on the day, or 1.10 percent, at 4,240.51 points.
The Dow rocketed 135 points to close unofficially at 7711.
